name: Colmcille
text: Colmcille, also spelled Colmkil, is a modern variant of the saint's name Colum Cille. The form drops the internal i of the older Irish Columb Cille. MacKillop treats both spellings as variants of one headword. His full article sits under Colum Cille. See Colum Cille.

attributes.attribute: variant spelling of the saint's name

okr.objective: Colmcille is a variant spelling of Colum Cille.
key_results: Colmcille and Colmkil are variant spellings of the Colum Cille name.
MacKillop folds both forms into his main article on the saint.
